content.text: {"sentences":[{"text":"The on-call rotation got woken up most nights by alerts that needed no action.","cites":[{"id":"s-oncall","quote":"The on-call rotation got woken up most nights by alerts that needed no action."}]},{"text":"I volunteered to look into it, with help from two teammates.","cites":[{"id":"s-oncall","quote":"I volunteered to look into it, with help from two teammates."}]},{"text":"We went through a month of alerts and I deleted the ones nobody acted on.","cites":[{"id":"s-oncall","quote":"We went through a month of alerts and I deleted the ones nobody acted on."}]},{"text":"Night pages went down to about one a week.","cites":[{"id":"s-oncall","quote":"Night pages went down to about one a week."}]}],"followUps":[]}
